r5_findings.title: Stage/status/receipt white-lists work against casual tamper, but public save+artifact can synthesize the entire workflow and close Gate 5.9

fixed_subparts.arbitrary_stage_status: FIXED: direct save stage/status outside whitelist throws; simple GATE_0.1 without artifact throws
fixed_subparts.public_event: FIXED: public Store.event accepts only CONFIG_FROZEN/P0_OPTIONAL_NOT_DISPATCHED
fixed_subparts.history_append: FIXED: history append requires registered artifact and allowed event/role

open_subparts.approval_artifact_forgery: OPEN: Store.artifact can create approval-0-1/0-2/5-9.json with arbitrary actor/receipt; #checkGateReceipt only checks self-registered digest/content
open_subparts.review_gate: OPEN: A_REVIEW_PASS (and B_REVIEW_PASS) moves to A_TEST/B_TEST without any Reviewer artifact or history
open_subparts.tester_p0_forgery: OPEN: fake tester-a/tester-b/p0 artifacts + history satisfy GATE_A_PASS/GATE_B_TEST_PASS/P0_INITIAL_COLLECTED
open_subparts.gate_5_9_self_consistency: OPEN: final-compliance.json and approval-5-9.json are caller-created; #validateFinalGate only checks DB/artifact self-consistency
open_subparts.full_chain: OPEN: 18 public save/artifact steps produced stage=CLOSED/status=APPROVED_FOR_SEPARATE_RELEASE_REVIEW with only synthetic Git commits and no real review/test/P0

r5_findings.observed: The new state machine blocks the simple R4-style attacks. However, it does not authenticate the evidence: any caller can register fake approval/TASK_SPEC/tester/P0/final-compliance artifacts and walk the allowed transitions. The independent probe reached CLOSED in 18 steps using only Store.save and Store.artifact, without tests/fixtures or direct SQLite writes. This directly violates the requirement that Gate 5.9 not close on field self-consistency.
r5_findings.minimal_fix: Do not treat caller-registered artifacts as proof. Require role-specific signed evidence (Reviewer/Tester/P0/HMAC), bind approvals to an authenticated principal and an external immutable anchor, and make Gate 5.9 require a verifier-produced compliance receipt rather than a caller-written final-compliance.json.

r5_findings.title: init() enforces Gate 0.1 start, zero budget, no preseeded spec/SHA/P0/Tester/history and validates frozen/policy/Soul
r5_findings.observed: 10/10 invalid init variants rejected: WAIT_GATE_59, READY, nonzero rounds, pre-set TASK_SPEC, currentSha, lastB/P0, nonempty history, forged frozen digest, inflated policy and bad Soul digest. Honest init accepted. tests/fixtures.mjs is imported only by test files; src/ and remote/ do not import it. The fixture is an explicit test-only SQLite resealer, not a production backdoor.
r5_findings.residual: A self-consistent but forged frozen snapshot can still be created; Gate 0.1 approval must bind it to a real principal (R6-003).

r5_findings.title: Git verifier is strict at freeze/approve/recovery, but Store Gate 5.9 save skips it and constructor verifier can be stubbed
r5_findings.observed: 13/13: real base->child accepted; missing SHA, tree object, blob object, wrong ancestor, worktree HEAD mismatch, missing/replaced worktree, previousSha not ancestor rejected. Store WORKTREE_PREPARED/A_COMMIT_FROZEN/B_COMMIT_FROZEN reject fake SHA atomically; Controller.approve Gate 5.9 and authorizeRecovery reject fake SHA. Missing/invalid verifier fails closed. Gap 1: Store.save(t,"GATE_5.9_APPROVED") does not call gitVerifier; replacing it with a throwing stub still closes CLOSED (R6-004). Gap 2: Store constructor accepts an arbitrary gitVerifier; ()=>true accepts fake SHA (R6-005).
r5_findings.residual: GATE_5.9 Store path lacks final Git re-verification; injectable verifier can disable trust. Controller.approve path does verify.
r5_findings.minimal_fix: Call gitVerifier inside #validateFinalGate/Store GATE_5.9 path; make the verifier non-injectable in production (module-private default, test-only factory) or tag/attest it.

r6_findings.title: Public Store.save+artifact can synthesize the full workflow and close Gate 5.9 with fabricated approvals/tests/P0/compliance
r6_findings.repro: Init honest WAIT_GATE_01; create approval-0-1.json/TASK_SPEC.md/approval-0-2.json via Store.artifact; save GATE_0.1_APPROVED, TASK_SPEC_CANDIDATE, GATE_0.2_APPROVED; real base/child Git commits for WORKTREE_PREPARED/A_COMMIT_FROZEN; A_REVIEW_PASS with no reviewer evidence; fake tester-a.json + TEST_RECEIPTS + GATE_A_PASS; fake p0-evidence.json + P0_COMPLETE + P0_INITIAL_COLLECTED; B_REMEDIATION_SKIPPED; fake tester-b.json + TEST_RECEIPTS + GATE_B_TEST_PASS; fake final-compliance.json + WAITING_HUMAN_GATE_5_9; fake approval-5-9.json + GATE_5.9_APPROVED -> CLOSED.
r6_findings.impact: 18/18 steps succeeded. Final state CLOSED/APPROVED_FOR_SEPARATE_RELEASE_REVIEW with aRound=1,bRound=1 and only synthetic Git commits; no real Planner/Worker/Reviewer/Tester/P0/human approval. verify() passes.
r6_findings.minimal_fix: Require verifier-produced role evidence and authenticated approvals; do not accept caller-written artifacts as proof; bind final-compliance to an independent verifier.

r6_findings.title: A_REVIEW_PASS/B_REVIEW_PASS can be claimed without Reviewer identity or evidence
r6_findings.repro: From A_REVIEW/READY, save(t,'A_REVIEW_PASS') moves to A_TEST with no reviewer artifact/history; the forged flow uses this step and reaches CLOSED.
r6_findings.impact: The independent double-review gate can be skipped entirely; only Tester/P0 artifacts are checked later.
r6_findings.minimal_fix: Require both spec_reviewer and quality_reviewer registered artifacts/history for the exact commit before A_REVIEW_PASS; same for B_REVIEW_PASS.

r6_findings.title: Gate 0.1/0.2/5.9 approvals bind only caller-created artifacts and string actor/receipt; no real human identity or external anchor
r6_findings.observed: approval-0-1/0-2/5-9.json are created by Store.artifact; #checkGateReceipt only checks gate/digest/actor/receipt strings and the registered digest. A caller can set actor='fake-human', receipt of sufficient length and close.
r6_findings.impact: Code-level self-consistency is not human authorization. This is distinct from R6-001: even with real role evidence, approval identity is unauthenticated.
r6_findings.minimal_fix: Bind approvals to an authenticated principal (OS account/SSH signature/HMAC key) and an external immutable anchor; mark real identity as NOT_VERIFIED until then.

r6_findings.title: Store GATE_5.9_APPROVED path does not re-run Git verifier; worktree HEAD drift can be ignored
r6_findings.repro: Run the forged flow to WAIT_GATE_59; replace store.gitVerifier with a function that throws; save GATE_5.9_APPROVED still succeeds and reaches CLOSED. Only Controller.approve calls verifyCommitEvidenceSync; Store.save does not.
r6_findings.impact: A direct Store GATE_5.9 closure can skip the final exact-HEAD/ancestry check. Combined with R6-001, it closes with stale or replaced worktree.
r6_findings.minimal_fix: Call gitVerifier in #validateFinalGate and in the Store GATE_5.9 save path before appending CLOSED.

r6_findings.title: Store constructor accepts an arbitrary gitVerifier; a ()=>true stub disables Git trust
r6_findings.repro: new Store(root,{gitVerifier:()=>true}); seed PREPARE/A_WORKER with baseSha=currentSha="f"*40 and a worktree path; save WORKTREE_PREPARED succeeds and verify() passes.
r6_findings.impact: The constructor asserts a function exists but cannot distinguish the production verifier from a stub. Tests need injection, but production has no attestation that verification is enabled.
r6_findings.minimal_fix: Keep a module-private production verifier and expose test injection only behind a test-only factory/flag; or record a signed verifier identity.
